anti_patterns.rule: Never use raw Unicode emojis in place of UI icons or decorative indicators.
anti_patterns.remedy: Replace with semantic, scalable SVG vector icons.

anti_patterns.rule: Avoid generic gradient tropes like bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 without brand rationale.
anti_patterns.remedy: Use purposeful OKLCH surface colors, edge lighting, or subtle monochromatic gradients.

anti_patterns.rule: Do not render 4+ identical grid cards with uniform height and iconography without visual cadence.
anti_patterns.remedy: Employ asymmetric bento layout, feature highlighting, or varying card densities.

anti_patterns.rule: Do not stack more than 2 backdrop-filter: blur() layers in the DOM.
anti_patterns.remedy: Limit to maximum 1-2 calibrated blur layers to prevent mobile GPU frame drops.

anti_patterns.rule: Interactive elements must not have dimensions below 44x44px on touch devices.
anti_patterns.remedy: Add padding or min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] hit areas.

anti_patterns.rule: Never remove focus outlines (outline: none) without providing an accessible focus-visible alternative.
anti_patterns.remedy: Style :focus-visible with prominent high-contrast offset rings.
